requires_api_key.description: The settings form asks for an API key. The refresh progress step reads this instead of loading the plugin.

skip_display_condition.description: The plugin implements skip_display_condition. The scheduler only loads the plugin in the main process to ask when this is true.

image_settings.description: Display hints for this plugin's frames, e.g. "keep-width" or "crisp" (rendered UI: undithered on colour e-ink).
